immune.usageZh: 形容词，免疫的。immune to/from；immune system。名词 immunity。医学/健康说明文。

examples.sentence: Sleep helps your immune system.
examples.trans: 睡眠帮助免疫系统。

examples.sentence: Vitamin C is not a magic immune shield.
examples.trans: 维生素C不是神奇的免疫盾。

examples.sentence: A balanced diet keeps the immune system ready.
examples.trans: 均衡饮食让免疫系统保持就绪。

examples.sentence: Being immune to a slogan is not the same as being immune to a virus.
examples.trans: 对口号免疫，不等于对病毒免疫。

examples.sentence: An immune public is built in kitchens and clinics, not only in ads.
examples.trans: 有免疫力的公众建在厨房和诊所，而不只在广告里。

examples.sentence: An immune public still needs soap, because language cannot wash a door handle.
examples.trans: 有免疫力的公众仍需要肥皂，因为语言洗不了门把手。

disease.usageZh: 可数或不可数名词。a disease, heart disease；prevent disease。形容词 diseased。

examples.sentence: Wash hands to stop disease.
examples.trans: 洗手以阻止疾病。

examples.sentence: Some diseases spread through dirty hands.
examples.trans: 有些疾病通过脏手传播。

examples.sentence: Guidelines help us fight with disease at home.
examples.trans: 准则帮助我们在家与疾病斗争。

examples.sentence: A disease that travels on a towel will not read your good mood.
examples.trans: 在毛巾上旅行的疾病，不会读你的好心情。

examples.sentence: We name lifestyle disease and underfund the water that would prevent it.
examples.trans: 我们命名生活方式疾病，却对能预防它的水拨款不足。

examples.sentence: To treat disease as a private failure is to forget the shared handle.
examples.trans: 把疾病当私人失败，就是忘记共用的把手。

guidelines.usageZh: 名词 guideline 的复数，准则。follow/issue guidelines。比 rules 软。

examples.sentence: Follow the class guidelines.
examples.trans: 遵守班规。

examples.sentence: The poster lists handwashing guidelines.
examples.trans: 海报列出洗手准则。

examples.sentence: Health guidelines say: wash before you prepare food.
examples.trans: 健康准则说：准备食物前洗手。

examples.sentence: Guidelines without soap are literature.
examples.trans: 没有肥皂的准则是文学。

examples.sentence: Ministries print guidelines and skip the sink.
examples.trans: 部门印刷准则，跳过水槽。

examples.sentence: Guidelines that cannot name running water have already chosen who stays dirty.
examples.trans: 叫不出自来水的准则，已经选好了谁继续脏着。

maintain.usageZh: 动词，保持。maintain a diet/habit；名词 maintenance。比 keep 正式。

examples.sentence: Maintain a smile.
examples.trans: 保持微笑。

examples.sentence: Maintain a balanced diet this week.
examples.trans: 这周保持均衡饮食。

examples.sentence: Regular exercise helps maintain muscle and mood.
examples.trans: 规律运动帮助保持肌肉和心情。

examples.sentence: To maintain health is to maintain a timetable for soap.
examples.trans: 保持健康，就是保持肥皂的时间表。

examples.sentence: Cities maintain slogans more carefully than they maintain taps.
examples.trans: 城市维持口号，比维持水龙头更仔细。

examples.sentence: What we fail to maintain in the sink we will maintain later in a ward.
examples.trans: 我们在水槽里未能维持的，稍后会在病房里维持。

balanced.usageZh: 形容词，均衡的。a balanced diet/life。动词 balance。副词 balanced 少用。

examples.sentence: Eat a balanced meal.
examples.trans: 吃一顿均衡的饭。

examples.sentence: A balanced diet includes fruit and protein.
examples.trans: 均衡饮食包括水果和蛋白质。

examples.sentence: Taking part in a balanced routine beats a weekend panic workout.
examples.trans: 参与均衡常规，胜过周末恐慌式锻炼。

examples.sentence: A balanced plate is a public decision wearing a private fork.
examples.trans: 均衡的盘子，是戴着私人叉子的公共决定。

examples.sentence: Balanced advice arrives from tables that are already full.
examples.trans: 均衡的建议来自已经满了的桌子。

examples.sentence: A balanced life that never counts washing-up is an accounting trick.
examples.trans: 从不计算洗碗的均衡生活，是一种会计把戏。

processed.usageZh: 形容词/过分，加工过的。processed foods。动词 process。对比 whole foods。

examples.sentence: This snack is processed.
examples.trans: 这零食是加工过的。

examples.sentence: Limit processed foods if you can.
examples.trans: 若可以，少吃加工食品。

examples.sentence: Processed foods are convenient and often low in fibre.
examples.trans: 加工食品方便，纤维常常低。

examples.sentence: A lunch of processed packets is eaten but not digested as care.
examples.trans: 一包加工食品的午餐被吃了，却没有作为关怀被消化。

examples.sentence: Processed convenience is sold to people whose kitchens were taken by overtime.
examples.trans: 加工便利卖给厨房被加班夺走的人。

examples.sentence: To moralise processed foods without naming wages is to lecture a vending machine.
examples.trans: 不点名工资却训诫加工食品，就是训斥一台售货机。

regular.usageZh: 形容词，规律的。regular exercise/check。副词 regularly。名词 regularity。

examples.sentence: We have regular PE.
examples.trans: 我们有规律的体育课。

examples.sentence: Take part in regular exercise.
examples.trans: 参加规律运动。

examples.sentence: Regular handwashing is more useful than a rare long shower.
examples.trans: 规律洗手比偶尔一次长淋浴更有用。

examples.sentence: Regular is a word the night shift hears as a joke.
examples.trans: “规律”是夜班听起来像笑话的词。

examples.sentence: Regular check-ups require time the poor are told they have.
examples.trans: 定期体检需要穷人被告知自己拥有的时间。

examples.sentence: A regular habit of soap is infrastructure, not a personality.
examples.trans: 肥皂的规律习惯是基础设施，不是性格。

physical.usageZh: 形容词，身体的。physical health/activity。副词 physically。对比 mental。

examples.sentence: Physical play is fun.
examples.trans: 身体上的玩耍很有趣。

examples.sentence: Physical exercise lifts your mood.
examples.trans: 体育锻炼提升心情。

examples.sentence: Physical health not only needs food but also sleep.
examples.trans: 身体健康不仅需要食物，也需要睡眠。

examples.sentence: Physical labour at a sink is still labour even when it looks like love.
examples.trans: 水槽边的体力劳动即使看起来像爱，也仍是劳动。

examples.sentence: We praise physical workouts and ignore physical washing.
examples.trans: 我们赞美体育锻炼，忽视体力上的洗涤。

examples.sentence: A physical body is not a metaphor; it is what germs actually meet.
examples.trans: 身体不是隐喻；它是细菌真正遇见的东西。

muscles.usageZh: 名词 muscle 的复数。build muscles；muscle tissue。不可数 muscle 也可。

examples.sentence: Sport builds muscles.
examples.trans: 运动增强肌肉。

examples.sentence: My muscles are sore after the workout.
examples.trans: 锻炼后我的肌肉酸痛。

examples.sentence: Protein helps muscles recover after exercise.
examples.trans: 蛋白质帮助肌肉在运动后恢复。

examples.sentence: Muscles that never rest will crave sugar as a false repair.
examples.trans: 从不休息的肌肉会把糖当假修复来渴望。

examples.sentence: Gyms sell muscles and skip the soap at the door.
examples.trans: 健身房出售肌肉，跳过门口的肥皂。

examples.sentence: A nation that funds muscles on posters and not water in schools has chosen its theatre.
examples.trans: 在海报上资助肌肉、在学校不资助水的国家，已经选好了它的剧场。

mood.usageZh: 可数名词，心情。in a good/bad mood；mood swings。形容词 moody。

examples.sentence: Music lifts my mood.
examples.trans: 音乐提升我的心情。

examples.sentence: A walk can change your mood.
examples.trans: 散步能改变心情。

examples.sentence: Exercise plays a role in mood as well as in muscles.
examples.trans: 运动对心情和肌肉都起作用。

examples.sentence: A mood cannot wash germs, though germs can wreck a mood.
examples.trans: 心情洗不了细菌，尽管细菌能毁掉心情。

examples.sentence: Workplaces manage mood with posters and skip the tap.
examples.trans: 职场用海报管理心情，跳过水龙头。

examples.sentence: To prescribe a better mood without soap is to medicalise a sink.
examples.trans: 没有肥皂却开出更好心情的处方，就是把水槽医学化。

workout.usageZh: 可数名词，锻炼。a gym workout。动词 work out。

examples.sentence: I did a short workout.
examples.trans: 我做了短暂锻炼。

examples.sentence: A daily workout helps muscles.
examples.trans: 每日锻炼帮助肌肉。

examples.sentence: Check with a doctor before a hard workout if you are recovering.
examples.trans: 若你在恢复，剧烈锻炼前先咨询医生。

examples.sentence: A workout that forgets water is only half a habit.
examples.trans: 忘记水的锻炼只是一半习惯。

examples.sentence: Paid workouts sit beside unpaid washing-up.
examples.trans: 付费锻炼坐在无酬洗碗旁边。

examples.sentence: The most advertised workout is still weaker than a tap that works.
examples.trans: 广告最多的锻炼，仍弱于一个能出水的龙头。

individual.usageZh: 可数名词/形容词，个人。each individual；individual needs。副词 individually。

examples.sentence: Each individual has a towel.
examples.trans: 每个人有一条毛巾。

examples.sentence: Wash as an individual habit and a public duty.
examples.trans: 把洗手既当个人习惯也当公共责任。

examples.sentence: An individual who never washes still shares the air.
examples.trans: 从不洗手的个人仍分享空气。

examples.sentence: Health that relies on the individual alone will fail at a shared tap.
examples.trans: 只依赖个人的健康会在共用龙头上失败。

examples.sentence: Guidelines blame the individual and spare the corridor.
examples.trans: 准则责备个人，放过走廊。

examples.sentence: An individual is a convenient unit for shame and an inconvenient one for pipes.
examples.trans: 个人是羞耻的方便单位，是管道的不便单位。

role.usageZh: 可数名词，作用、角色。play a role in；the role of soap。

examples.sentence: Soap plays a role in cleaning.
examples.trans: 肥皂在清洁中起作用。

examples.sentence: Sleep plays a role in recovering.
examples.trans: 睡眠在恢复中起作用。

examples.sentence: Water plays a role in almost every body function.
examples.trans: 水在几乎每项身体功能中起作用。

examples.sentence: The role of a towel is not to decorate the sink.
examples.trans: 毛巾的作用不是装饰水槽。

examples.sentence: Ads give soap a hero's role and give time no role at all.
examples.trans: 广告给肥皂一个英雄角色，给时间完全不给角色。

examples.sentence: Whoever names the role of germs without naming the queue names only half the play.
examples.trans: 点名细菌角色却不点名队列的人，只点名了半出戏。

recovering.usageZh: 动词 recover 的 -ing，恢复。recover from illness。名词 recovery。

examples.sentence: He is recovering from a cold.
examples.trans: 他正在从感冒中恢复。

examples.sentence: Sleep aids recovering muscles.
examples.trans: 睡眠帮助正在恢复的肌肉。

examples.sentence: Check with a doctor if you are still recovering.
examples.trans: 若你仍在恢复，咨询医生。

examples.sentence: Recovering is work; soap is one of its tools.
examples.trans: 恢复是工作；肥皂是工具之一。

examples.sentence: A city recovering from a virus still underpays the people who wash.
examples.trans: 从病毒中恢复的城市，仍给洗手的人低薪。

examples.sentence: Recovering without running water is a speech, not a plan.
examples.trans: 没有自来水的恢复是演讲，不是计划。

aids.usageZh: 动词 aid 的第三人称或名词 aid 的复数，帮助。aid sb in doing。注意 AIDS 疾病缩写本课不作该义。

examples.sentence: A friend aids me with bags.
examples.trans: 朋友帮我提包。

examples.sentence: Water aids every body function.
examples.trans: 水有助于每项身体功能。

examples.sentence: Sleep aids hormones that repair tissues.
examples.trans: 睡眠帮助修复组织的激素。

examples.sentence: Soap aids the hands; time aids the soap.
examples.trans: 肥皂帮助手；时间帮助肥皂。

examples.sentence: A poster aids memory; a tap aids survival.
examples.trans: 海报帮助记忆，水龙头帮助存活。

examples.sentence: What aids a slogan rarely aids the night cleaner.
examples.trans: 帮助口号的，很少帮助夜班清洁工。

hormones.usageZh: 名词 hormone 的复数。growth hormones；hormone levels。科学用语。

examples.sentence: The body makes hormones.
examples.trans: 身体制造激素。

examples.sentence: Sleep helps hormones work well.
examples.trans: 睡眠帮助激素正常工作。

examples.sentence: Exercise and rest both shape hormones.
examples.trans: 运动和休息都塑造激素。

examples.sentence: Hormones will not read a guideline that never lets you sleep.
examples.trans: 激素不会阅读从不让你睡觉的准则。

examples.sentence: We talk about hormones as fate and about soap as optional.
examples.trans: 我们把激素当命运谈，把肥皂当选修谈。

examples.sentence: A timetable that wrecks hormones and then sells a workout has a sense of humour.
examples.trans: 摧毁激素再出售锻炼的时间表，是有幽默感的。

viruses.usageZh: 名词 virus 的复数。viruses spread；a virus。形容词 viral。

examples.sentence: Wash hands to move viruses away.
examples.trans: 洗手把病毒移走。

examples.sentence: Viruses can live on a door for hours.
examples.trans: 病毒可以在门上活数小时。

examples.sentence: Although you cannot keep away from all viruses, washing helps.
examples.trans: 尽管你无法远离所有病毒，洗手仍有帮助。

examples.sentence: Viruses do not care about your mood; they care about your towel.
examples.trans: 病毒不关心你的心情；它们关心你的毛巾。

examples.sentence: Fear of viruses sells bottles and skips the communal tap.
examples.trans: 对病毒的恐惧出售瓶子，跳过公共龙头。

examples.sentence: A public that can spell viruses but cannot reach soap has been educated backwards.
examples.trans: 会拼 viruses 却够不着肥皂的公众，被教育反了。

essential.usageZh: 形容词，必不可少。essential to/for；It is essential that/to。比 necessary 更强。

examples.sentence: Water is essential.
examples.trans: 水是必不可少的。

examples.sentence: Soap is essential before you eat.
examples.trans: 吃东西前肥皂必不可少。

examples.sentence: Water is essential to keep your body's functions working.
examples.trans: 水对保持身体功能运转必不可少。

examples.sentence: Time at the sink is as essential as the soap itself.
examples.trans: 在水槽边的时间与肥皂本身一样必不可少。

examples.sentence: Essential on a poster may be absent from the corridor.
examples.trans: 海报上必不可少的，走廊里可能没有。

examples.sentence: It is essential to ask who dries their hands on a dirty towel because there is no other.
examples.trans: 必须问谁因为没有别的毛巾而在脏毛巾上擦手。

function.usageZh: 名词/动词。body function；function as。形容词 functional。

examples.sentence: The heart's function is to pump.
examples.trans: 心脏的功能是泵血。

examples.sentence: Water helps the body function.
examples.trans: 水帮助身体运转。

examples.sentence: Sleep is essential for brain function.
examples.trans: 睡眠对脑功能必不可少。

examples.sentence: A tap that does not function makes every guideline fiction.
examples.trans: 不运转的龙头让每条准则都变成虚构。

examples.sentence: The function of a poster is to look busy.
examples.trans: 海报的功能是看起来忙碌。

examples.sentence: When soap cannot function because time cannot, the body will function as a warning.
examples.trans: 当肥皂因为时间不能而不能运转，身体就会作为警告运转。

replace.usageZh: 动词，替换、补充。replace A with B；replace lost water。名词 replacement。

examples.sentence: Replace the old soap.
examples.trans: 换掉旧肥皂。

examples.sentence: Drink water to replace what you lose.
examples.trans: 喝水补充你失去的。

examples.sentence: You cannot replace handwashing with perfume.
examples.trans: 你不能用香水替换洗手。

examples.sentence: Replacing sleep with a workout replaces repair with display.
examples.trans: 用锻炼替换睡眠，就是用展示替换修复。

examples.sentence: Cities replace taps with slogans and wonder why germs stay.
examples.trans: 城市用口号替换龙头，然后奇怪细菌为何留下。

examples.sentence: Nothing replaces running water, though many things replace the courage to fund it.
examples.trans: 没有什么能替换自来水，尽管许多东西能替换资助它的勇气。

germs.usageZh: 名词 germ 的复数，病菌。kill/wash away germs。口语健康教育高频。

examples.sentence: Germs are on dirty hands.
examples.trans: 病菌在脏手上。

examples.sentence: Soap helps wash germs away.
examples.trans: 肥皂帮助洗掉病菌。

examples.sentence: You don't kill all germs; you wash them away.
examples.trans: 你不会杀死所有病菌；你把它们洗掉。

examples.sentence: Germs at hand are not a moral story; they are a map of touch.
examples.trans: 手边的病菌不是道德故事；它们是一张触摸地图。

examples.sentence: We talk about germs as enemies and about cleaners as extras.
examples.trans: 我们把病菌当敌人谈，把清洁工当群众演员谈。

examples.sentence: A war on germs that never names the towel is a war on someone else's skin.
examples.trans: 从不点名毛巾的细菌战争，是对别人皮肤的战争。

transfer.usageZh: 动词/名词，传播、转移。transfer germs from A to B。名词 transfer。

examples.sentence: Don't transfer dirt to the towel.
examples.trans: 不要把脏东西转到毛巾上。

examples.sentence: Hands transfer germs to food.
examples.trans: 手把病菌传到食物上。

examples.sentence: Sneezing can transfer viruses across a desk.
examples.trans: 打喷嚏能把病毒传到桌子对面。

examples.sentence: What we transfer with a handshake we also transfer with a shared tap.
examples.trans: 我们随握手转移的，也随共用龙头转移。

examples.sentence: Offices transfer blame faster than they transfer soap.
examples.trans: 办公室转移责备，快于转移肥皂。

examples.sentence: To transfer responsibility onto children without transferring soap into schools is a sermon.
examples.trans: 把责任转给孩子却不把肥皂转进学校，那是布道。

frequently.usageZh: 副词，频繁地。wash frequently；形容词 frequent。对比 occasionally。

examples.sentence: Wash frequently.
examples.trans: 勤洗手。

examples.sentence: He washes his hands frequently at school.
examples.trans: 他在学校频繁洗手。

examples.sentence: Washing frequently can limit the spread of germs.
examples.trans: 频繁洗手能限制病菌传播。

examples.sentence: Frequently is easy to print and hard to practise without a tap.
examples.trans: “频繁”容易印刷，没有龙头难以实践。

examples.sentence: Staff wash frequently; guests are told they are clean enough.
examples.trans: 员工频繁洗；客人被告知已经够干净。

examples.sentence: A city that cannot fund soap frequently will fund wards frequently.
examples.trans: 无法频繁资助肥皂的城市，会频繁资助病房。

properly.usageZh: 副词，正确地。wash properly；形容词 proper。

examples.sentence: Wash properly with soap.
examples.trans: 用肥皂好好洗。

examples.sentence: Dry your hands properly on a clean towel.
examples.trans: 在干净毛巾上好好擦干手。

examples.sentence: If you don't wash properly, germs stay at hand.
examples.trans: 若你洗得不彻底，病菌仍在手边。

examples.sentence: Properly means twenty seconds, not a splash for the camera.
examples.trans: 正确地意味着二十秒，不是给镜头溅一下。

examples.sentence: Guidelines say properly; corridors say hurry.
examples.trans: 准则说正确地；走廊说快点。

examples.sentence: Nothing is properly clean if the towel is a rumour.
examples.trans: 若毛巾是谣言，就没有什么是真正干净的。

prepare.usageZh: 动词，准备。prepare food；prepare to do。名词 preparation。

examples.sentence: Prepare your bag.
examples.trans: 准备你的包。

examples.sentence: Wash before you prepare food.
examples.trans: 准备食物前洗手。

examples.sentence: You should wash your hands before you prepare food or eat.
examples.trans: 准备食物或吃饭前应洗手。

examples.sentence: To prepare food with dirty hands is to prepare a message.
examples.trans: 用脏手准备食物，就是准备一条信息。

examples.sentence: Kitchens prepare meals; posters prepare guilt.
examples.trans: 厨房准备饭；海报准备愧疚。

examples.sentence: Whoever prepares the guideline but not the soap prepares a play.
examples.trans: 准备准则却不准备肥皂的人，准备的是一出戏。

toilet.usageZh: 可数名词，厕所。go to the toilet；toilet paper。课后洗手强相关。

examples.sentence: Wash after the toilet.
examples.trans: 上厕所后洗手。

examples.sentence: There is soap at the toilet.
examples.trans: 厕所里有肥皂。

examples.sentence: Always wash your hands after using the toilet.
examples.trans: 用完厕所后一定洗手。

examples.sentence: A toilet without soap is a half-built sentence.
examples.trans: 没有肥皂的厕所，是半截句子。

examples.sentence: Public toilets tell you the truth of a city's hands.
examples.trans: 公共厕所告诉你一座城市之手的真相。

examples.sentence: Funding a marble lobby and a dry toilet is a theory of whose skin matters.
examples.trans: 资助大理石大堂和干燥厕所，是一套关于谁的皮肤要紧的理论。

sneezing.usageZh: 动词 sneeze 的 -ing。cover your mouth when sneezing。名词 a sneeze。

examples.sentence: Cover your mouth when sneezing.
examples.trans: 打喷嚏时捂嘴。

examples.sentence: Sneezing can spread droplets.
examples.trans: 打喷嚏会传播飞沫。

examples.sentence: Wash after sneezing, not only after the toilet.
examples.trans: 打喷嚏后也要洗，不只是厕所后。

examples.sentence: Sneezing into a hand that then prepares food is a short play with a long ending.
examples.trans: 对着随后准备食物的手打喷嚏，是短戏长结局。

examples.sentence: We fear sneezing in the lift and forget the unwashed rail.
examples.trans: 我们害怕电梯里的喷嚏，忘记未洗的扶手。

examples.sentence: A culture polite about sneezing and rude about soap has its manners backwards.
examples.trans: 对喷嚏礼貌、对肥皂粗鲁的文化，礼貌是反的。

waste.usageZh: 名词/动词。animal waste；waste water；Don't waste soap。本课也可指排泄物。

examples.sentence: Don't waste water.
examples.trans: 不要浪费水。

examples.sentence: Keep away from animal waste in the park.
examples.trans: 在公园远离动物粪便。

examples.sentence: Hands can pick up germs from waste you cannot see.
examples.trans: 手会从看不见的污物上沾上病菌。

examples.sentence: Waste that is not named still transfers.
examples.trans: 未被命名的污物仍会转移。

examples.sentence: We waste posters on guilt and waste no money on taps.
examples.trans: 我们把海报浪费在愧疚上，不把钱浪费在龙头上。

examples.sentence: A city that treats care workers as waste will drink that decision later.
examples.trans: 把护工当废物的城市，稍后会喝下那个决定。

soap.usageZh: 不可数名词（一块可 a bar of soap）。wash with soap；soap and water。

examples.sentence: Use soap, not only water.
examples.trans: 用肥皂，不要只用清水。

examples.sentence: Apply soap to your palms and rub.
examples.trans: 把肥皂抹在手心并揉搓。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands with soap and water to keep yourself safe.
examples.trans: 用肥皂和水洗手以保护自己。

examples.sentence: Soap without twenty seconds is theatre.
examples.trans: 没有二十秒的肥皂是戏剧。

examples.sentence: Soap is cheap; time at the sink is what offices refuse to budget.
examples.trans: 肥皂便宜；水槽边的时间是办公室拒绝预算的。

examples.sentence: A civilization is a rumour until the soap is as public as the slogan.
examples.trans: 直到肥皂和口号一样公共，文明才不只是谣言。

apply.usageZh: 动词，涂抹；应用。apply soap/cream；apply for a job 是另一义。名词 application。

examples.sentence: Apply soap to your hands.
examples.trans: 把肥皂抹到手上。

examples.sentence: Apply it to wrists and fingernails too.
examples.trans: 手腕和指甲也要抹到。

examples.sentence: Apply soap, rub, rinse, then dry your hands.
examples.trans: 抹肥皂、揉搓、冲洗，然后擦干手。

examples.sentence: Apply the guideline where the tap actually is.
examples.trans: 把准则涂在龙头真正所在之处。

examples.sentence: We apply science to bottles and superstition to shared towels.
examples.trans: 我们把科学用于瓶子，把迷信用于共用毛巾。

examples.sentence: To apply shame instead of soap is a very old public-health error.
examples.trans: 用羞耻代替肥皂，是一种很老的公共卫生错误。

rub.usageZh: 动词，揉搓。rub your hands together；rub soap in。名词 a rub。

examples.sentence: Rub your hands together.
examples.trans: 双手互相揉搓。

examples.sentence: Rub soap over your wrists.
examples.trans: 在手腕上揉搓肥皂。

examples.sentence: Rub long enough to cover fingernails.
examples.trans: 揉够久，盖住指甲。

examples.sentence: Rub is a verb that needs seconds, not a pose.
examples.trans: 揉搓是一个需要秒数的动词，不是姿势。

examples.sentence: Cameras love the start of a rub and skip the rinse.
examples.trans: 镜头爱揉搓的开始，跳过冲洗。

examples.sentence: A twenty-second rub is a small constitution: it says your hands are worth time.
examples.trans: 二十秒的揉搓是一部小宪法：它说你的手值得时间。

wrists.usageZh: 名词 wrist 的复数，手腕。wash your wrists。

examples.sentence: Wash your wrists too.
examples.trans: 手腕也要洗。

examples.sentence: Germs hide on wrists and nails.
examples.trans: 病菌藏在手腕和指甲上。

examples.sentence: Apply soap to palms, backs, wrists and fingernails.
examples.trans: 手心、手背、手腕和指甲都要抹肥皂。

examples.sentence: Wrists are where a hurried wash admits it was theatre.
examples.trans: 手腕是匆忙的洗承认自己是戏剧的地方。

examples.sentence: Jewellery on wrists is pretty; soap under it is the point.
examples.trans: 手腕上的首饰好看；下面的肥皂才是重点。

examples.sentence: A guideline that never reaches the wrists has not reached the hands.
examples.trans: 从不到达手腕的准则，也没有到达手。

fingernails.usageZh: 名词，指甲。clean your fingernails；germs under fingernails。

examples.sentence: Clean your fingernails.
examples.trans: 把指甲弄干净。

examples.sentence: Rub soap under your fingernails.
examples.trans: 在指甲下揉搓肥皂。

examples.sentence: Fingernails keep germs if you rush the wash.
examples.trans: 若你赶着洗，指甲会留住病菌。

examples.sentence: Fingernails are a small geography of what we touched.
examples.trans: 指甲是我们所触之物的小地理。

examples.sentence: Manicures are photographed; fingernails at a sink are not.
examples.trans: 美甲被拍照；水槽边的指甲不会。

examples.sentence: Public health that cannot speak of fingernails cannot speak of food.
examples.trans: 不能谈论指甲的公共卫生，也不能谈论食物。

towel.usageZh: 可数名词。a clean towel；dry your hands on a towel。动词 towel off。

examples.sentence: Use a clean towel.
examples.trans: 用干净毛巾。

examples.sentence: Dry your hands on a towel, not on your shirt.
examples.trans: 在毛巾上擦干手，不要在衬衫上。

examples.sentence: A dirty towel can put germs back on clean hands.
examples.trans: 脏毛巾能把病菌放回干净的手上。

examples.sentence: The towel is the last sentence of the wash; if it lies, the paragraph fails.
examples.trans: 毛巾是洗的最后一句；若它说谎，整段就失败。

examples.sentence: Shared towels are a kindness that can become a vector.
examples.trans: 共用毛巾是一种可以变成媒介的善意。

examples.sentence: A school with marble words and one wet towel has already written its outbreak.
examples.trans: 有大理石词句和一条湿毛巾的学校，已经写好了它的爆发。

impossible.usageZh: 形容词，不可能的。It is impossible to + V；impossible for sb to。名词 impossibility。

examples.sentence: It is impossible to fly.
examples.trans: 飞是不可能的。

examples.sentence: It is impossible to keep away from all germs.
examples.trans: 远离所有病菌是不可能的。

examples.sentence: Although it's impossible to avoid every virus, washing helps.
examples.trans: 尽管不可能避开每种病毒，洗手仍有帮助。

examples.sentence: It is impossible to wash properly in a queue of forty and one tap.
examples.trans: 四十人一队一个龙头，不可能洗得彻底。

examples.sentence: Impossible is what offices call a twenty-second wash.
examples.trans: 办公室把二十秒的洗叫做不可能。

examples.sentence: Calling soap impossible is how a budget becomes a philosophy.
examples.trans: 把肥皂叫做不可能，是预算变成哲学的方式。

limit.usageZh: 动词/名词，限制。limit the spread；a time limit。形容词 limited。

examples.sentence: Limit sweets.
examples.trans: 少吃甜食。

examples.sentence: Washing can limit germs on your hands.
examples.trans: 洗手能限制手上的病菌。

examples.sentence: Frequent washing can limit how far viruses transfer.
examples.trans: 频繁洗手能限制病毒传播多远。

examples.sentence: A limit on soap is a limit on who may enter the day clean.
examples.trans: 对肥皂的限制，就是对谁可以干净进入一天的限制。

examples.sentence: We limit children's snacks and do not limit overtime.
examples.trans: 我们限制孩子的零食，不限制加班。

examples.sentence: To limit infection without lifting the limit on taps is to limit the poor.
examples.trans: 不提高龙头上限却限制感染，就是限制穷人。

average.usageZh: 形容词/名词。on average；the average person。

examples.sentence: The average class has forty students.
examples.trans: 普通一个班有四十人。

examples.sentence: On average people touch their faces often.
examples.trans: 人们平均常常摸脸。

examples.sentence: The average towel in a rush is not as clean as we hope.
examples.trans: 匆忙中普通的毛巾没有我们希望的那么干净。

examples.sentence: The average pair of hands is a public surface.
examples.trans: 普通的一双手是公共表面。

examples.sentence: On average, advice is cheaper than soap in a school.
examples.trans: 平均而言，建议比学校里的肥皂便宜。

examples.sentence: What the average body meets at a handle is the city's unwritten guideline.
examples.trans: 普通身体在把手上遇见的，是城市未写下的准则。

fight with.usageZh: 短语，与……斗争。fight with disease。也可 fight with sb 吵架，本课对抗义。

examples.sentence: We fight with dirt using soap.
examples.trans: 我们用肥皂与脏斗争。

examples.sentence: Sleep helps us fight with disease.
examples.trans: 睡眠帮助我们与疾病斗争。

examples.sentence: Guidelines help families fight with germs at home.
examples.trans: 准则帮助家庭在家与病菌斗争。

examples.sentence: You cannot fight with viruses using mood alone.
examples.trans: 不能只用心情与病毒斗争。

examples.sentence: Cities fight with posters and wonder why the viruses stay.
examples.trans: 城市用海报斗争，然后奇怪病毒为何留下。

examples.sentence: To fight with disease while refusing taps is to fight with a slogan.
examples.trans: 拒绝龙头却与疾病斗争，就是与口号斗争。

develop habits.usageZh: 动词短语，养成习惯。develop good habits。

examples.sentence: Develop habits of washing.
examples.trans: 养成洗手的习惯。

examples.sentence: Children develop habits at the sink.
examples.trans: 孩子在水槽边养成习惯。

examples.sentence: Develop habits that a Tuesday can keep.
examples.trans: 养成周二还能保持的习惯。

examples.sentence: Schools that develop habits of soap develop fewer outbreaks.
examples.trans: 养成肥皂习惯的学校，爆发更少。

examples.sentence: Apps develop habits of tracking and skip habits of rinsing.
examples.trans: 应用养成打卡习惯，跳过冲洗习惯。

examples.sentence: A state that will not develop habits of funding taps will develop habits of blaming hands.
examples.trans: 不愿养成资助龙头习惯的国家，会养成责备手的习惯。

balanced diet.usageZh: 名词短语，均衡饮食。eat/maintain a balanced diet。

examples.sentence: Eat a balanced diet.
examples.trans: 吃均衡饮食。

examples.sentence: A balanced diet includes vegetables.
examples.trans: 均衡饮食包括蔬菜。

examples.sentence: A balanced diet not only feeds muscles but also mood.
examples.trans: 均衡饮食不仅喂肌肉，也喂心情。

examples.sentence: A balanced diet needs a kitchen, not only a poster.
examples.trans: 均衡饮食需要厨房，而不只是海报。

examples.sentence: Lectures on a balanced diet come from tables already full.
examples.trans: 关于均衡饮食的训诫，来自已经满了的桌子。

examples.sentence: A balanced diet without time is a riddle set for the tired.
examples.trans: 没有时间的均衡饮食，是给疲倦者出的谜。

processed foods.usageZh: 名词短语，加工食品。limit processed foods。

examples.sentence: I eat few processed foods.
examples.trans: 我很少吃加工食品。

examples.sentence: Limit processed foods after sport.
examples.trans: 运动后少吃加工食品。

examples.sentence: Processed foods are easy and often low in fibre.
examples.trans: 加工食品容易，纤维常常低。

examples.sentence: Processed foods fill the gap a missing canteen leaves.
examples.trans: 加工食品填补缺失食堂留下的缝。

examples.sentence: Night shifts live on processed foods and morning lectures.
examples.trans: 夜班靠加工食品和早晨训诫活着。

examples.sentence: To shame processed foods without naming overtime is to miss the plot.
examples.trans: 不点名加班却羞辱加工食品，就是没看懂情节。

take part in.usageZh: 动词短语，参加。take part in regular exercise。

examples.sentence: Take part in the game.
examples.trans: 参加游戏。

examples.sentence: Take part in regular exercise.
examples.trans: 参加规律运动。

examples.sentence: Students take part in exercise to keep healthy.
examples.trans: 学生参加运动以保持健康。

examples.sentence: To take part in health is to take part in the sink, not only the gym.
examples.trans: 参与健康，就是参与水槽，而不只是健身房。

examples.sentence: Those who do not take part in washing still take part in the air.
examples.trans: 不参与洗的人，仍参与空气。

examples.sentence: A survey that never asks who failed to take part in soap will declare hygiene.
examples.trans: 从不问谁没参与肥皂的调查，会宣布卫生。

check with.usageZh: 短语，向……核实。check with a doctor。

examples.sentence: Check with Mum first.
examples.trans: 先问妈妈。

examples.sentence: Check with a doctor before a hard workout.
examples.trans: 剧烈锻炼前咨询医生。

examples.sentence: If you are recovering, check with a doctor.
examples.trans: 若你在恢复，咨询医生。

examples.sentence: Check with the body, not only with the app.
examples.trans: 问问身体，而不只是应用。

examples.sentence: Offices check with legal and never check with the tap.
examples.trans: 办公室问法务，从不问龙头。

examples.sentence: A campaign that will not check with cleaners has already checked out of reality.
examples.trans: 不愿向清洁工核实的运动，已经从现实退房。

pay attention to.usageZh: 动词短语，注意。pay attention to fingernails/guidelines。

examples.sentence: Pay attention to the teacher.
examples.trans: 注意听老师。

examples.sentence: Pay attention to your wrists when you wash.
examples.trans: 洗的时候注意手腕。

examples.sentence: Pay attention to soap, not only to water.
examples.trans: 注意肥皂，而不只是水。

examples.sentence: Pay attention to the towel; it can undo the wash.
examples.trans: 注意毛巾；它可以撤销这一洗。

examples.sentence: We pay attention to viruses on screens and not to soap in schools.
examples.trans: 我们注意屏幕上的病毒，不注意学校里的肥皂。

examples.sentence: A public that pays attention to slogans and not to sinks will pay later in wards.
examples.trans: 注意口号不注意水槽的公众，稍后会在病房里付钱。

play a role in.usageZh: 动词短语，在……中起作用。play a role in health。

examples.sentence: Sleep plays a role in growth.
examples.trans: 睡眠在生长中起作用。

examples.sentence: Water plays a role in every function.
examples.trans: 水在每项功能中起作用。

examples.sentence: Exercise plays a role in mood as well as muscles.
examples.trans: 运动对心情和肌肉都起作用。

examples.sentence: Soap plays a role in health that perfume cannot steal.
examples.trans: 肥皂在健康中起香水偷不走的作用。

examples.sentence: Cleaners play a role in immunity that posters never cast.
examples.trans: 清洁工在免疫中起海报从不饰演的作用。

examples.sentence: Whoever plays a role in writing guidelines should play a role in funding taps.
examples.trans: 在写准则中起作用的人，应在资助龙头中起作用。

defend against.usageZh: 动词短语，抵御。defend against germs/disease。

examples.sentence: A coat defends against cold.
examples.trans: 外套抵御寒冷。

examples.sentence: Soap helps defend against germs.
examples.trans: 肥皂帮助抵御病菌。

examples.sentence: Sleep and food defend against disease together.
examples.trans: 睡眠和食物一起抵御疾病。

examples.sentence: You cannot defend against viruses with mood music.
examples.trans: 不能用心情音乐抵御病毒。

examples.sentence: Cities defend against headlines and not against dry toilets.
examples.trans: 城市抵御头条，不抵御干燥厕所。

examples.sentence: A body asked to defend against everything except a missing tap has been given the wrong war.
examples.trans: 被要求抵御除了缺失龙头之外的一切的身体，被给定了错误的战争。

at hand.usageZh: 短语，在手边。keep water at hand；也指即将发生。

examples.sentence: Keep soap at hand.
examples.trans: 把肥皂放在手边。

examples.sentence: Keep a bottle of water at hand.
examples.trans: 手边放一瓶水。

examples.sentence: Keep a bottle of water at hand to drink during the day.
examples.trans: 白天手边放瓶水喝。

examples.sentence: Germs at hand are a map, not a scandal.
examples.trans: 手边的病菌是地图，不是丑闻。

examples.sentence: Slogans are at hand; soap is in a locked cupboard.
examples.trans: 口号在手边；肥皂在锁着的柜里。

examples.sentence: A guideline not at hand at the sink is not a guideline.
examples.trans: 不在水槽手边的准则，不是准则。

wash your hands.usageZh: 祈使/动词短语，洗手。wash your hands with soap。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands before lunch.
examples.trans: 午饭前洗手。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands after the toilet.
examples.trans: 上厕所后洗手。

examples.sentence: You should always wash your hands before you prepare food.
examples.trans: 准备食物前应洗手。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands as if the next person were already at the table.
examples.trans: 洗手时要像下一个人已经在桌边。

examples.sentence: Signs say wash your hands; doors have no soap.
examples.trans: 标语说洗手；门边没有肥皂。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands is easy to print and expensive to make possible.
examples.trans: “洗手”容易印刷，要使它成为可能却昂贵。

keep away from.usageZh: 短语，远离。keep away from germs。

examples.sentence: Keep away from the wet floor.
examples.trans: 远离湿地板。

examples.sentence: Keep away from animal waste.
examples.trans: 远离动物粪便。

examples.sentence: Although it's impossible to keep away from all germs, washing helps.
examples.trans: 尽管不可能远离所有病菌，洗手仍有帮助。

examples.sentence: Keep away from dirty towels as well as from dirty hands.
examples.trans: 远离脏毛巾，也远离脏手。

examples.sentence: Advice says keep away from viruses and stay glued to overtime.
examples.trans: 建议说远离病毒，并继续粘在加班上。

examples.sentence: You cannot keep away from a handle the city refuses to wash.
examples.trans: 你无法远离一座城市拒绝去洗的把手。

wash away.usageZh: 短语动词，洗掉。wash germs away。

examples.sentence: Wash the dirt away.
examples.trans: 把脏东西洗掉。

examples.sentence: Soap can wash germs away.
examples.trans: 肥皂能把病菌洗掉。

examples.sentence: You wash viruses away from your hands onto the towel if it is dirty.
examples.trans: 若毛巾脏，你把病毒从手上洗到毛巾上。

examples.sentence: Washing away is not killing; it is moving the map.
examples.trans: 洗掉不是杀死；是移动地图。

examples.sentence: We wash away guilt with posters and leave the rail.
examples.trans: 我们用海报洗掉愧疚，留下扶手。

examples.sentence: What is not washed away at the sink is washed into the next handshake.
examples.trans: 水槽边没洗掉的，会洗进下一次握手。

blow your nose.usageZh: 动词短语，擤鼻涕。blow one's nose。之后要洗手。

examples.sentence: Blow your nose with a tissue.
examples.trans: 用纸巾擤鼻涕。

examples.sentence: Wash after you blow your nose.
examples.trans: 擤完鼻涕洗手。

examples.sentence: Sneezing and blowing your nose both ask for soap.
examples.trans: 打喷嚏和擤鼻涕都要求肥皂。

examples.sentence: Blow your nose, then wash, or the tissue was only theatre.
examples.trans: 擤鼻涕然后洗，否则纸巾只是戏剧。

examples.sentence: Offices fear people who blow their nose and love people who never leave the desk.
examples.trans: 办公室害怕擤鼻涕的人，爱从不离开桌子的人。

examples.sentence: A culture that cannot say blow your nose cannot say wash your hands either.
examples.trans: 不能说擤鼻涕的文化，也不能说洗手。

prepare food.usageZh: 动词短语，准备食物。wash before you prepare food。

examples.sentence: I help prepare food.
examples.trans: 我帮忙准备食物。

examples.sentence: Wash before you prepare food.
examples.trans: 准备食物前洗手。

examples.sentence: You should wash your hands before you prepare food or eat.
examples.trans: 准备食物或吃饭前应洗手。

examples.sentence: To prepare food is to prepare other people's immunity.
examples.trans: 准备食物，就是准备别人的免疫。

examples.sentence: Kitchens prepare food; posters prepare fear.
examples.trans: 厨房准备食物；海报准备恐惧。

examples.sentence: Whoever prepares food with a dirty towel prepares a lesson the outbreak will mark.
examples.trans: 用脏毛巾准备食物的人，准备的是爆发会打分的一课。

on average.usageZh: 短语，平均而言。on average + 句子。

examples.sentence: On average I sleep eight hours.
examples.trans: 我平均睡八小时。

examples.sentence: On average people touch their faces often.
examples.trans: 人们平均常常摸脸。

examples.sentence: On average a rushed wash misses the wrists.
examples.trans: 平均而言，匆忙的洗会漏掉手腕。

examples.sentence: On average the guideline is shorter than the queue.
examples.trans: 平均而言，准则比队列短。

examples.sentence: On average, soap is cheaper than a slogan.
examples.trans: 平均而言，肥皂比口号便宜。

examples.sentence: On average a city loves clean photographs more than clean hands.
examples.trans: 平均而言，一座城市爱干净照片胜过干净的手。

running water.usageZh: 名词短语，自来水、流动的水。clean running water。

examples.sentence: Wash with running water.
examples.trans: 用流动的水洗。

examples.sentence: Wet your hands with clean running water.
examples.trans: 用干净的自来水打湿手。

examples.sentence: Use running water—warm or cold—then soap.
examples.trans: 用自来水——温的或冷的——然后肥皂。

examples.sentence: Running water is the quiet half of every guideline.
examples.trans: 自来水是每条准则安静的一半。

examples.sentence: Schools print running water and live with a dry tap.

grammar.key: Not only... but also... / 不仅...而且...
grammar.title: 不仅……而且……（并列强调）
grammar.usage:
not only ... but also ... 连接两个对等成分，强调“两者都成立，后者同样重要”。
对等：两个名词 / 两个动词 / 两个形容词 / 两个介词短语 / 两个从句。
主语不同且 not only 置于句首时，前一分句常用部分倒装：Not only does soap kill germs, but it also rinses them off.
also 可省略：not only A but B。
相关：both A and B（两者同等）；as well as（侧重前者）；not only ... but ... as well。
卫生语境：洗手不仅冲走污垢，而且打断传播链。
forms: not only A but also B（A、B 词性/结构对等）
Not only + 助动词 + 主语 + 动词, but (also) ...（句首倒装）
both A and B / A as well as B
notes: A、B 词性不一致是大错：not only soap but also washing（动名词对不上名词）。
句首 Not only 后要用倒装，but also 后一般不倒装。
also 放在 but 后，不要写成 but also not。

grammar.usage:
动名词 V-ing 可作主语，强调整个活动：Taking part in regular exercise is essential.
形式主语 It is + adj. + to-v / that：It is essential to take part in exercise.
不定式作主语更偏具体、未发生的动作；动名词更偏习惯、已认知的活动。
所有格/宾格：Your washing / You washing the wound helps.
否定：Not washing after the toilet spreads germs.
卫生：Washing with soap, drying with a clean towel, sneezing into a tissue — 都可作主语。
notes: 不要用原形动词直接作主语：Wash hands is important ×。
动名词主语通常视为单数：is/helps。
forgetting 与 to forget 作主语时意义不同，但考试更常考 V-ing 习惯。

grammar.key: Modal Verb 'can' for Ability/Possibility / 情态动词'can'表能力/可能性
grammar.title: can / could / be able to / may / might：能力与可能（卫生）
grammar.titleEn: Can, could, be able to, may, might
grammar.usage:
can + 动词原形：现在能力或客观可能。Soap can wash germs away.
could：过去能力，或更弱/更礼貌的可能。When I was five I could not reach the tap.
be able to 可进入各种时态：will be able to, have been able to。某次成功常用 was able to / managed to，不宜只用 could。
may / might：许可或可能性，might 更弱。May I use the sink? Germs might stay on a dirty towel.
must：义务或很有把握的推断。You must replace the water you lose. You must be thirsty after PE.
should：建议，弱于 must。can't 表不可能或没有能力。否定：cannot/can't；没有 don't can。
卫生语境：洗手能限制传播，但不能让人“免疫口号”。
forms: could 过去能力或委婉可能
must 义务/推断 vs should 建议
notes: can 后无 to、无 -s：cans / can to 都错。
将来能力用 will be able to，不用 will can。
某次做成了用 was able to / managed to。
mustn't 禁止；can't 也可表不可能。

grammar.title: should / ought to / had better / must / needn't：卫生建议
grammar.usage:
should + 动词原形：建议或“正确做法”，弱于 must。You should always wash your hands before you prepare food or eat.

ought to 更正式，接近 should，to 不能丢。
